review: Independent bounded diagnostic and CI integration review
scope: Diagnostic observation, process ownership, deadlines, cleanup, output minimization, and preservation of the separate unchanged acceptance command. No product or assertion changes are approved by this record.

correctedFindings.issue: Playwright detaches Firefox into a separate Unix process group; killing only the diagnostic worker could leave it alive.
correctedFindings.resolution: Public launchServer process PID is registered before connection/page operations. Supervisor signals each registered group independently and checks absence.

correctedFindings.issue: Concurrent supervisor reads could see a truncated PID-registration JSON file.
correctedFindings.resolution: All worker and final supervisor writes use a same-directory temporary file followed by atomic rename.

correctedFindings.issue: The cleanup probe deadline could expire within the bounded startup window.
correctedFindings.resolution: Probe deadline increased to 20s, beyond 8s Vite startup plus 7.5s launch/connect stage.

correctedFindings.issue: Signal callbacks did not preserve the interruption name.
correctedFindings.resolution: Named SIGINT/SIGTERM wrappers preserve the signal in the diagnostic result and enter cleanup.

correctedFindings.issue: A failed observational diagnostic could skip full acceptance by default workflow semantics.
correctedFindings.resolution: The diagnostic step has a 2-minute timeout; verify uses if: !cancelled(). Diagnostic failure remains a job failure while full verification still runs unless cancelled.

server.suppliedURL: Only plain credential-free local HTTP URLs are accepted.

verifiedBoundaries.browserServer: Bound to 127.0.0.1; websocket endpoint is not retained.
verifiedBoundaries.isolation: Three sequential fresh headless Firefox variants, each with fresh contexts for blank, legacy, and twin pages.
verifiedBoundaries.observations: Native requestAnimationFrame and 100ms timer counters, selected numeric scene diagnostics, canvas/WebGL metadata, document readiness/visibility/focus, and ordinary view clicks.
verifiedBoundaries.output: Bounded diagnostic JSON only: no screenshots, traces, recordings, page text, cookies, request headers, credentials, or websocket endpoint.
verifiedBoundaries.interpretation: COLLECTED means observations were collected, including any recorded errors; it is not PASS or proof of a Firefox CI root cause. WebGL renderer strings do not prove the selected compositor.

forcedTimeout.probe: A real launched Firefox is left open until the supervisor deadline.
